selected_items.summary: The kernel permits an external Codex capability supervisor only as bounded advisory support while Provider validation, post-build finalization, local_packager, public delivery gate, and delivery manifest remain authoritative.

The reviewed formal generation implementation owns planning, Provider component generation, semantic repair, post-build processing, and evidence handoff. It previously had no validated Codex brief input.
A bounded offline mock-Provider evaluation generated an executable compact FocusForge project, but it did not prove that formal Provider generation consumed the brief.
